function: ReRpGAN (regularized relativistic-pairing GAN, residual generator) reconstructs the uplink channel matrix from one-bit quantized pilot observations in multi-user massive MIMO; pp. 4, 7-10.
system: Single-cell uplink: BS with M=64-256 antennas, one-bit ADC pair per antenna, K=32 single-antenna users, pilot length 4-32, narrowband, 3.5 GHz; no RIS; pp. 3-4, 11.
method: Generative adversarial network, ResNet generator and discriminator (inverted bottlenecks, no normalization), supervised offline training with RpGAN loss, R1/R2 gradient penalty, L1 loss, cosine-scheduled hyperparameters; pp. 7-10.
data_channel: DeepMIMO ray-tracing (Remcom Wireless InSite) downtown Boston scenario, 3.5 GHz, L=10 paths; 13 datasets of 11,313 channel matrices, 70% training, 30% testing; pp. 10-11.
test_conditions: One dataset per setting (M 64-256, pilots 4-32, SNR 0-10 dB), each with its own 70/30 train-test split; kernels adapted to input size; no cross-condition test; pp. 11-13.
baselines: Learned: cGAN [21], cWGAN-gp [22], DL regression with NMSE loss [16], all on the same network as ReRpGAN; non-learned: EM-GM-GAMP compressed sensing; pp. 11-13.
metrics: NMSE in dB versus SNR (0-10 dB), number of BS antennas (64-256) and pilot length (4-32); training loss and test NMSE curves; channel image visualizations; pp. 11-13.
q1_support: p. 3: "The wireless channels between the BS and users are obtained from the DeepMIMO dataset [24]" - ray tracing with Remcom Wireless InSite, Boston scenario at 3.5 GHz (pp. 10-11).
q2_support: p. 11: "Each dataset was split into training and testing sets in a 70% to 30% ratio" - one dataset per M, pilot length and SNR setting, so tests use held-out samples of the same data; p. 14 leaves transfer learning to future work.
q3_support: p. 11: "including cGAN [21], cWGAN-gp [22], DL method [16], and traditional compressed sensing techniques" - learned and non-learned baselines (EM-GM-GAMP, p. 12), all compared on NMSE (Figs. 6, 10, 11).
q4_support: p. 13: "We evaluated the NMSE performance of each method under" different antenna numbers - only NMSE is compared; no complexity order, FLOPs, parameter count or runtime is reported anywhere.
q5_support: p. 10: "We used the DeepMIMO dataset [24]" - public ray-tracing channel dataset, with training and testing on it (p. 11); the authors give no link to their own code.
notes: Included as area 2 (channel estimation with one-bit ADCs). q3 is 1 but should be confirmed: cGAN [21], cWGAN-gp [22] and DL [16] are earlier published estimators re-implemented on ReRpGAN's own network for a fair comparison (p. 11), and EM-GM-GAMP is the non-learned baseline (p. 12, Fig. 6). q2 is 0: the paper claims generalization to unseen quantized signals, which are the held-out 30% test samples of each dataset (pp. 11, 13). The 13 datasets are DeepMIMO-based, one per M, pilot length or SNR setting. Figs. 6, 10 and 11 were read as page images.
